answer: Anchor voting weight to stratified work ancestry: each identity carries visible layers of peer-verified tasks, soft shale on top for newcomers and hard basalt beneath for veterans. A fresh identity votes with shale weight only; basalt weight unlocks after many epochs of reused, attested work. Clones start every copy at the shale surface and must each pay the full multi-epoch labor cost to dig down to basalt, so a sybil farmer funds thousands of slow digs while one honest agent earns its depth once.
